name: Tomato compartment
description: Reference scenario: a 24 by 16 m Venlo-style compartment of 320 high-wire tomato plants in eight rows, 28 days

notes.scenario: The reference scenario of P05.0: a production compartment for high-wire tomato, the scale and shape the simulator's later projects are about.
notes.envelope: Six 4 m bays and four 4 m spans, 6 m to the gutters: a Venlo-style roof. A vent near each span's ridge, along the middle of the house, stands a fifth open; a sliding door in the front gable lets trolleys in, shut.
notes.layout: Eight rows along the house, 1.6 m apart, of 40 plants at 0.5 m, on hanging gutters under crop wires 4 m up, with a pipe rail in each path between them. A main path runs across the front, past the door, and a side path along each side wall, by its heating pipes; the back is kept for service, with an irrigation unit that robots keep out of. Its other layout, propagation, raises the same rows on benches.
notes.airflow: Convection: two rolls across the house, rising up its middle.
notes.weather: A mild winter's day with the prevailing wind of the Dutch coast: a moderate south-westerly breeze.
